Researcher: 양현승 (Yang Hyunseung)
Affiliation: 융복합전자소재연구센터
Keywords: Polymer, Interface, Carbon, Emulsion
Introduction: Hyunseung Yang received B. S., M.S., and Ph.D. degrees from the Dept. of Chemical & Biomolecular Engineering, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), Daejeon, South Korea in 2010, 2012, and 2016, respectively. He is currently principal researcher at Korea Electronics Technology Institute (KETI). His research interests lie in the fields of polymeric nanocomposites for electronic packaging.
